faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.intro: Short answers about the studio. Anything else? Mail us at

faq.q: How does it work?
faq.a: Type what you want — a renaissance painting, a Christmas card, your cat as an astronaut — and attach a photo of your pet. Our AI writes the perfect prompt from your words, then paints a new picture that keeps your pet's face, fur and eyes. It takes about half a minute.

faq.q: Will it still look like my pet?
faq.a: Yes — that's the whole point. One clear, face-on photo is enough to start; adding one or two extra angles (a side view, a sitting pose) makes the face and fur even more consistent. We don't promise every portrait is pixel-perfect, but it should always read as your pet.

faq.q: What kind of photos should I upload?
faq.a: Up to 4 photos, JPG/PNG/WebP, each under 5 MB. Best results: your pet alone in the frame, face visible, in good light. No people in the photo, please — the picture is for pets only.

faq.q: What can I ask for in the chat box?
faq.a: Anything: a scene, an outfit, an art style, a mood — or pick one of our 100 ready-made templates and just add your twist. Keep requests about your pet; requests involving people or unsafe content are filtered out.

faq.q: Is it free? How many pictures can I make?
faq.a: You can make 3 pictures a day for free — no account needed to create. Signing in (with Google) is only required when you want to download and keep them. The counter resets every day.

faq.q: Why do I need to sign in to download?
faq.a: Generating is open to everyone, but downloading requires a free Google sign-in. It protects your pictures and keeps the free daily quota fair. We only store your Google name, email and profile picture.

faq.q: Are these images really AI-generated?
faq.a: Yes, 100%. Every picture is generated by an AI image model from the photos you upload. We label it honestly everywhere, and we ask you not to present AI portraits as unedited photographs. See our AI disclosure page for details.

faq.q: What happens to my photos?
faq.a: Your photos are used only to generate your picture. They're not sold, not used to train models, and uploads are automatically deleted within 7 days. You can publish a result to the public gallery yourself — that's always opt-in.

faq.q: Can I use the pictures commercially or as a gift?
faq.a: Yes — print them on cards, post them on social media, gift them to family. The pictures are yours to enjoy. Just keep the AI-generated labeling when you share, and don't use them to mislead.

faq.q: Why does a generation sometimes fail or look off?
faq.a: AI painting is a live service — the studio can hiccup under load, and tricky photos (blurry, dark, multiple pets) can confuse the result. Just try again, ideally with a clearer photo. Regenerating is free and usually fixes it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: PetsDaily is a website that turns pet photos into AI-generated pictures. This policy explains, in plain words, what we collect and what happens to it.

body: Photos you upload, the text you type into the generator, and the pictures we generate for you. A random ID stored in a cookie so we can apply the free daily limit. If you post to the public gallery: the name, pet name and review you choose to submit.

If you sign in (required only for downloading pictures): your Google name, email and profile picture, plus a signed session cookie that keeps you signed in for 180 days. We never see or store your Google password.
We don't show ads and don't use tracking cookies.
Only to generate your picture and keep the product working (rate limits, error fixing). We do not sell your photos or generated images. We do not use your photos to train AI models.

To create your picture we send the uploaded photo and a short text prompt to our AI service providers: a language model (Zhipu AI) that writes the image prompt, and an image model (Volcengine / BytePlus Seedream) that paints the picture. They process your photo only to return a result to us, under their own privacy and security terms.

Pictures become public only when you choose to: by sharing a picture's link yourself, or by posting it to the public gallery (submissions are reviewed before publishing, and you can ask us to remove one at any time).
Uploaded photos are deleted automatically within 7 days. Generated pictures may be kept a little longer so your share link keeps working; ask us and we'll delete yours sooner.

You can ask us for a copy of the data linked to your device or account, ask for corrections, or ask for deletion. Email us and we'll respond within 30 days. Our lawful basis is your consent and our legitimate interest in operating the service. California residents have the right to know and delete — we do not discriminate for exercising these rights.
PetsDaily is for adults. Please don't upload photos of children or use the service if you are under 16 (under 13 in the US).
If this policy changes materially we'll update the date above. The version on this page is always the current one.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: Welcome! These terms govern your use of PetsDaily. By using the site you agree to them.

body: PetsDaily turns a photo of your pet into an AI-generated picture. You can make up to 3 pictures per day for free (we may change this limit; the current rules are always shown in the product). Generating needs no account; downloading pictures requires signing in with Google.
Sign-in uses Google OAuth — we receive your name, email and profile picture and store a signed session cookie for 180 days. You are responsible for your Google account. You can sign out anytime.

Only photos of pets you own or have permission to use. No people, no photos of children, nothing illegal, harmful, hateful or explicit. We filter requests automatically and can refuse or remove anything that breaks these terms.

Results are generated by AI and are provided as-is: we can't promise a specific likeness or artistic result. You may use your generated pictures for personal purposes — share them, print them, gift them. Don't present an AI image as an unedited photograph, and don't use generated pictures to mislead, defame, or impersonate.

Posting to the public gallery is voluntary. When you submit, you confirm the picture is your creation from your own photo, and you give us permission to display it on the site. You can ask us to remove it anytime.

The service is provided "as is" without warranties. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages. We may pause or change the service for maintenance or improvement.
Questions: email us. These terms are governed by the laws of the operator's place of business, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections in your country of residence.

ai.title: AI disclosure
ai.intro: Transparency matters. PetsDaily produces AI-generated images, and here's exactly what that means.

body: Every image on this site — templates, examples and gallery — was created by an AI image model. No image is an unedited photograph of a real animal event.

When you use the studio, a language model (GLM by Zhipu AI) rewrites your request into a detailed image prompt. An image model (Seedream by Volcengine/BytePlus) then paints the picture, using your uploaded photo only as a reference for your pet's identity — face, fur markings and eye color.
Uploaded photos are not used to train any AI model, ours or theirs.

The site footer and the AI pages state that all portraits are AI-generated. Gallery captions say so too. We ask you to keep this honesty when sharing: don't present an AI portrait as an unedited photo or use it to enter "real photo" contests.
We block requests that involve people (especially minors), violence, explicit content, trademarks or public figures. If you spot a generated image that concerns you, email us and we'll act on it.

dogPage.title: Dog name generator
dogPage.sub: 100+ dog name ideas with meanings — filter by style and gender, save your favorites, and find the one that fits.

faq.q: What are the most popular dog names?
faq.a: Year after year, Max, Bella, Charlie and Luna top the lists. Classic human names stay popular because they're easy to call out at the park — and they age well with your dog.

faq.q: How do I choose a good dog name?
faq.a: Short names with one or two syllables are easiest for dogs to recognize. Avoid names that sound like common commands (like "Kit" for "sit"), and pick something you won't be embarrassed to shout across a field.

faq.q: Should dog names be human names?
faq.a: Both work! Human names (Charlie, Daisy) feel like a family member; food and funny names (Waffles, Pickles) show personality. Our generator mixes all styles — filter to the vibe you want.

catPage.title: Cat name generator
catPage.sub: 100+ cat name ideas with meanings — filter by style and gender, save your favorites, and find the one that fits.

faq.q: What are the most popular cat names?
faq.a: Luna, Oliver, Bella and Milo are perennial favorites. Moon-and-space names (Luna, Nova, Cosmo) are especially loved for cats — fitting for creatures of the night.

faq.q: How do I choose a good cat name?
faq.a: Cats respond best to short names ending in a bright "ee" sound (Kiki, Mochi, Rosie). Watch your cat for a day — a name that matches their habits (Noodle, Shadow, Zoomies) always fits better than a trendy one.

faq.q: Can I rename an adopted cat?
faq.a: Yes — cats adapt to new names within days to weeks. Use the new name consistently with treats and play, and keep sounds distinct from other pets' names and common words like "no".

age.title: Pet age calculator
age.sub: Enter your cat or dog's age and see it in human years — plus their life stage.

faq.q: How do cat years work?
faq.a: Cats mature fast, then slow down: the first cat year counts as about 15 human years, the second adds 9, and every year after adds about 4. An indoor cat's second decade is roughly a human's 70s and 80s.

faq.q: Is one dog year really seven human years?
faq.a: No — that's a myth. Dogs mature much faster early on: the first year counts ~15 human years. After that, bigger dogs age faster than small ones, which is why our calculator asks for your dog's size.

faq.q: When is my pet a senior?
faq.a: Cats are usually considered senior around 11. For dogs it depends on size: small dogs around 11, medium around 9, and large breeds as early as 7. Regular vet checks matter more as they reach these ages.
